verdict.rationale: Decagon's Insights product supports open-ended analysis of customer conversations, heatmaps to spot spikes/dips in metrics, and Watchtower flags natural-language-defined issues in real time, which together approximate topic clustering and emerging-issue detection. However, there's no explicit documentation of automatic topic clustering or proactive alerting before ticket volume spikes specifically — the emphasis is on ad-hoc querying and dashboards rather than autonomous surfacing of emerging trends. Missing for 10: explicit topic-clustering mechanism, evidence of predictive/early-warning alerting tied to ticket volume trends, and independent validation of this analytics capability.
